colosse-os.description: a bone colossus: a huge chaotic giant made of many random bones and skulls, horned skull head with glowing red eyes, holding a huge thigh bone club, old yellowed bone color
colosse-os.sujet: a huge giant made of many bones and skulls, horned skull head, holding a huge thigh bone club
colosse-os.notes: D'après une image de l'utilisateur, en plus simple (style rétro). Sur une seule case. Lent : 7 images par seconde.

chevalier.description: a medieval knight: full grey steel plate armor, closed great helm with a narrow visor slit, broad armored shoulders, a deep royal blue kite shield with a thin gold rim and a golden fleur-de-lis on his left arm, a spiked flail ball on a chain held in his right hand, sturdy heroic stance
chevalier.sujet: a medieval knight in full steel plate armor with a closed great helm, a blue kite shield with a golden fleur-de-lis and a spiked flail
references: art-candidats/references/chevalier-reference.png::subject reference only (armor, flail, shield), not the style and not the camera angle
chevalier.notes: Remplacera l'Épéiste. Les candidats sortaient tournés vers la gauche (miroir). Bouclier changé avec « retoucher » de pixellab.py.

fantome.description: a drowned woman ghost floating above the ground, very pale and ethereal, almost white with soft cyan glow, long wet hair hiding a dark hollow face with two faint glowing eyes, thin arms with long clawed fingers reaching forward, ragged gown fading into misty wisps instead of feet
fantome.sujet: a pale ghost of a drowned woman floating above the ground, long wet hair, clawed hands, ragged gown fading into wisps
references: art-candidats/references/fantome-reference.png::concept reference only (veiled ghost bride in a long flowing gown): simplify it a lot, do not copy its camera angle or its realistic modern style
fantome.notes: Futur mort-vivant. Son attaque projette une gerbe d'eau (gardée, choix de l'utilisateur).

archer.description: a medieval army archer in light armor: steel kettle hat, a royal blue tabard with a small golden fleur-de-lis on the chest over a grey gambison, leather belt with a quiver of arrows, sturdy boots, holding a tall longbow, strong confident stance
archer.sujet: a medieval archer with a steel kettle hat, blue tabard with a golden fleur-de-lis, holding a longbow
references: art-candidats/references/archer-reference.jpg::costume reference only, not the style and not the camera angle

mouvements.attack: quick shot: lifts the bow, pulls the string fully back aiming to the right, lets go, then lowers the bow; the arrow is not shown flying

archer.notes: Refait le 2026-11-06. La corde de l'arc est tracée par l'outil (« corde »). Il regarde autour de lui, rarement.

lots.L1: références (ancien archer + image de l'utilisateur), costume rayé

consignes.idle: subtle idle: slow calm breathing and one small movement, the feet stay in place

moine.description: a monk in a brown hooded robe holding a staff topped with a glowing orb
moine.sujet: a monk in a brown hooded robe holding a staff topped with a glowing orb

mouvements.attack: the monk leans forward and stretches his arm, pointing the glowing orb of his staff at the enemy, then steps back to rest; nothing is thrown

moine.notes: Image d'origine gardée (modèle de style). La boule de feu sera un effet du jeu : l'attaque ne lance rien.

loup.sujet: a dark grey wolf, side view facing right, snarling

zombie.description: a bloated plague zombie: a fat swollen undead man with grey-purple dead skin, a huge round belly covered with oozing yellow pustules, a small bald head with a gaping toothy mouth and blank white eyes, a few purple crystal spikes growing from his back and shoulders, thick arms dripping with slime, bare feet, shuffling
zombie.sujet: a bloated fat grey zombie with a huge belly covered in yellow pustules and purple spikes on its back
references: art-candidats/references/zombie-reference.jpg::concept reference only (bloated plague zombie): simplify it a lot, retro game sprite, do not copy its camera angle or its realistic modern style

mouvements.idle: the bloated zombie slowly raises one hand and reaches forward, its gaping mouth opens wider, then the arm sinks back down, the feet stay in place
mouvements.attack: lurches forward and slams both heavy arms down on the enemy in front of it, then sways back to its starting pose
mouvements.move: limping very slowly forward to the right on a crippled leg: one stiff leg is dragged behind at every step, the body lurches and leans heavily to one side, the belly wobbles

zombie.notes: Futur mort-vivant (premier niveau). D'après une image de « zombie boursouflé » de l'utilisateur, en plus simple. Niveau 2 : plus petit que l'Archer (44 px). Marche lente, une jambe infirme.

consignes.idle: the bloated zombie slowly raises one hand and reaches forward, its gaping mouth opens wider, then the arm sinks back down, the feet stay in place
consignes.attack: the bloated zombie leans far back on its heels, its enormous round belly swelling even bigger, then it thrusts the huge belly forward with all its weight toward the enemy in front of it, then rocks back to its starting pose
consignes.move: the bloated zombie walks forward to the right very slowly and heavily, small shuffling steps, its huge belly swaying from side to side with each step

troll.description: a huge hulking green troll with massive muscular arms and big fists, small head, hunched shoulders
troll.sujet: a huge hulking green troll with massive arms and big fists

mouvements.idle: the troll breathes slowly and heavily, its huge shoulders rise and fall, it flexes its big fingers, the feet stay in place
mouvements.attack: the troll raises both huge fists high above its head, then brings them down hard in front of it with all its weight, then straightens up to its starting pose
mouvements.move: the troll walks forward to the right with slow heavy stomping steps, its long arms swinging, its shoulders rolling

troll.notes: Image d'origine gardée (modèle de style). Il se régénère (capacité) : l'effet viendra du jeu.

consignes.attack: the troll pulls one huge fist far back behind its shoulder, twisting its whole body, then throws a gigantic straight punch forward to the right with all its weight, its arm fully stretched, then slowly pulls back to its starting pose
consignes.idle: the troll slowly lifts one huge hand and scratches the top of its head with its thick fingers, looking puzzled, then lowers the arm back down, the feet stay in place

ogre.description: a huge wild man ogre with long black hair and a thick black beard, a fur loincloth, holding a big plain wooden club without nails
ogre.sujet: a huge wild man ogre with long black hair, a black beard and a big wooden club

mouvements.move: the ogre walks forward to the right with heavy steps, the club resting on his shoulder

ogre.notes: Fait avant l'outil (session du 2026-11-04) : sa grande image n'a que 66 px. Attente et attaque refaites le 2026-11-06.

consignes.attack: the ogre lifts his big wooden club high over his head with both hands, then brings it down in a heavy arc in front of him to the right, his whole body leaning into the swing, then raises it back to his starting pose

griffon.description: a griffon with the body of a lion, the head of an eagle and large brown feathered wings raised
griffon.sujet: a griffon with a lion body, an eagle head and large brown wings, side view facing right

mouvements.idle: the griffon stands still, ruffles and slightly opens its raised wings, turns its eagle head a little, its tail swishes, the paws stay in place
mouvements.attack: the griffon rears up on its hind legs with its wings spread wide, then lunges forward and rakes with its front talons and snaps its beak at the enemy in front of it, then lands back in its starting pose
mouvements.move: the griffon flies forward to the right: it beats its large wings strongly, rises a little off the ground with its paws tucked, and glides forward

griffon.notes: Image d'origine gardée (modèle de style). Il vole : sa « marche » est un vol.

consignes.move: the griffon hovers in place a little above the ground, beating its large wings up and down in a steady flying cycle, its paws tucked under its body, facing right, it stays at the same place
